summary: You need 45 graduate units: EPI 225 and 226 (letter graded, B- or better), EPI 251 unless you are in one of the designated tracks, the three biostatistics courses (letter graded, B- or better), three quarters of the EPI 236 seminar, MED 255, 11 units of electives, and at least two quarters of EPI 399 totaling 12 units, of which only 12 count toward the 45. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, your track if you skip EPI 251, a MED 255 waiver for an IRB principal investigator, and the master's thesis and its seminar presentation; EPI electives your advisor approves are moved in by hand. The optional concentrations' own course lists are not checked.
